final_answers.question: 真正技术障碍是什么？
final_answers.answer: Identity-only pairing ABI cannot evaluate arbitrary GT targets; full original parser/FS/GT/semantic preservation and total staged resource schedule are missing, not just a Solidity function.

final_answers.question: G9 已解决哪些问题？
final_answers.answer: Pinned wire/transcript conformance and one endpoint; identified ten equations plus G1 endpoint, B2 source/formulas, sentinel issue and continuation skeleton; documented failed full64 spend. Not a complete verifier.

final_answers.question: 是否有明确可审计的多交易实现路线？
final_answers.answer: Only a source-mapped design skeleton. Complete transition implementation, supported-domain acceptance semantics and terminal equivalence remain unproven.

final_answers.question: 哪些资源上界未知？
final_answers.answer: Complete parse/FS/GT/Miller/final-exponent and checkpoint costs; full per-step/total Gas, maximum transactions/live storage/runtime and practical rejection-sampling admission remain null.

final_answers.question: 能否进入 B2 完整 EVM？
final_answers.answer: No. G12 is BLOCKED; no G13, no partial-check acceptance and no cap increase.

final_answers.question: 替代方向是什么？
final_answers.answer: Prioritize a separately authorized B guest-portability/semantics review; C is a redesign fallback. Neither is implemented or known cheaper. Preserve current real individual-proof fallback and disclose its non-SnarkPack boundary.
